dict.捏捏乐很解压，但真的捏捏会脏、会坏，也没法随身带上几十种手感。AirSquish: Squishies are great for stress, but real ones get dirty, wear out, and you can't carry dozens of textures around. AirSquishy is a virtual squishy that never breaks: open the page and start squeezing — no space, no cost. Reach out your hand and press, pinch, pull and squeeze it in thin air. When studying or work gets tiring, take a minute or two to squish and let your mind go blank.
dict.打开摄像头，把手伸到屏幕前：弯手指是按，拇指和食指捏合是捏起，捏住再移动是拉；两: Turn on your camera and reach toward the screen: bend a finger to press, pinch thumb and index finger to lift, then move to pull. Both hands can squeeze, press and stretch together. A 5-step gesture guide runs the first time.
dict.按住不动越按越深，按住拖动拉长，右键或空格整团握紧；手机上两根手指可以一起捏。: Hold still to sink deeper, hold and drag to stretch, right-click or Space to squeeze the whole thing. On phones, two fingers can pinch together.

dict.画面只在你的浏览器里实时识别手的位置，不录像、不上传、不保存。关掉摄像头就立刻停: The video is only used inside your browser to track your hands in real time. Nothing is recorded, uploaded or saved, and it stops the moment you turn the camera off.
dict.不需要账号，不收集姓名、邮箱等个人信息。: No account needed. No names, emails or other personal info collected.
dict.只在你自己的浏览器里记住「做过教学没有」「最近捏过哪几个」，清除浏览器数据就没了: Your own browser remembers whether you've done the guide and which squishies you used recently. Clearing your browser data removes it.

dict.软壳里装着凝胶和彩色珠子，按哪里别处就鼓起来: A soft shell filled with gel and colorful beads. Press one spot and another bulges.
dict.史莱姆：按住会往四周流、包住手指；点一下戳洞，戳到气泡会“啵”；按下立刻拖拉出黏: Slime: hold and it spreads around your finger. Tap to poke a hole, and bubbles go "pop". Drag right away to pull strings. Let go and it slowly levels out.
dict.凝胶珠填充：按哪里，里面的凝胶就被挤到别处鼓起来；松手后还会晃几下。半透明外壳能: Gel & Beads: press one spot and the gel bulges somewhere else, then wobbles when you let go. You can watch the gel and beads move through the clear shell.
dict.硅胶：点一下是戳，按住是按压，按住停一下再移动是揉搓，按下立刻拖是拉长；按住 S: Silicone: tap to poke, hold to press, hold then move to knead, drag right away to stretch. Hold Shift and press to pinch.
dict.黏土：按住停一下再移动 = 揉搓；按下立刻拖 = 拉长；按住 Shift 再按: Clay: hold then move to knead, drag right away to stretch, hold Shift and press to pinch. The shape stays until you press "Reset shape".

dict.揉捏：按住停一下再小幅移动是揉搓；按住 Shift 再按是捏起；摄像头下拇指食指: Knead: hold, pause, then move a little. Hold Shift and press to pinch. With the camera, pinch thumb and index finger.
dict.拉伸：一按下立刻拖动就能拉长，拉太远会“啪”地弹回；摄像头下捏住再移动，双手可以: Stretch: drag right away to pull it long. Too far and it snaps back. With the camera, pinch and move; use both hands to stretch.

dict.把手移到捏捏上，让指尖落在捏捏上（指尖变成白色空心圈），再弯曲手指往下按。手指伸: Move your hand over the squishy so a fingertip rests on it (a hollow white circle), then bend that finger to press. A straight finger does not press.
dict.单手捏住往外拉: Pinch and pull with one hand
dict.只用一只手：拇指和食指捏住捏捏的边缘，捏紧（外圈走满一圈），再往外拉。: Use one hand: pinch the edge with thumb and index finger until the outer ring fills up, then pull outward.
dict.双手捏住两边往外拉: Pinch both sides and pull apart
dict.两只手分别用拇指和食指捏住捏捏的左右两边，两边都捏紧后，同时往外拉。: Pinch the left and right sides with each hand. Once both are tight, pull them apart.
dict.两个捏合点都在捏捏上: Both pinch points on the squishy
dict.两只手张开、掌心相对，放在捏捏左右两边（或一上一下），先稳住一下，再慢慢往中间合: Open both hands with palms facing each other on either side (or above and below). Hold steady, then slowly bring them together.
